title: Days-on-Market Strategy – When and How to Adjust Price
excerpt: Most buyer interest concentrates in the first 2–3 weeks.
body:
People searching Austin-area real estate for “why is my house not selling Austin”, “when to reduce price on listing”, and “days on market too high Texas” want a local, practical answer.

Most buyer interest concentrates in the first 2–3 weeks. After 30–45 days with limited traffic, a strategic price adjustment calibrated to current comps often restarts activity.

Multiple small reductions can signal desperation; one well-timed, meaningful reduction usually performs better.

Track showing feedback and online views. Adjust based on data, not frustration.
